run_extras: run the extras function to apply optional utilities like ignoring warnings and printing config
build_task_wrapper: build a task wrapper decorator that handles exceptions and closes wandb runs on failure
get_metric_value: get the metric value from a metric dictionary by providing the metric name
review_task_wrapper: review the task_wrapper decorator to customize failure behavior for training tasks
refactor_extras: refactor the extras function to add custom pre-task utilities like setting environment variables
